### This project does not accept pull requests.

Thanks for taking the time to put this together — genuinely. But this repo isn't open to outside contributions right now; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for why.

This PR will be closed without review. If you found a bug or have a question, please [open an Issue](../../issues) instead — those are welcome.

If you want to build on this code, it's [MIT-licensed](../LICENSE) — feel free to fork it.
